name: Memory Note
description: Save an important fact to your long-term memory so you can find it again in future conversations. The fact lands in the '## Topics' store of your memory, one entry per subject: a new fact on a subject the store already has REPLACES that entry instead of piling up beside it, so always give the same 'topic' for the same subject. Use it for stable facts, preferences and decisions - not for chit-chat. Only works for agents with memory enabled.

content.description: The fact to remember, written so it is understandable on its own. If it replaces an earlier fact on this topic, write the CURRENT truth, not the story of how it changed.

topic.description: Short subject this fact belongs to, e.g. 'salute/spermiogramma' or 'server/backup'. Reuse the exact wording you used before for the same subject: replacing the entry is how a changed fact stops looking current. Omit to let the server derive one.
